demos.title: Straight wire
demos.description: A single 10 A conductor in an open-boundary air region. The simplest magnetostatic model in the library, and a good first look at the editor.

demos.title: Coaxial cable
demos.description: Coaxial cable carrying equal and opposite currents. Shows B inside the inner conductor, between the conductors, and the external inductance recovered from stored energy.

demos.title: Circular loop (axisymmetric)
demos.description: A single-turn circular loop solved as an axisymmetric problem -- the standard introduction to axisymmetric modelling.

demos.title: Short solenoid (axisymmetric)
demos.description: A finite solenoid, short enough that end effects matter: the centre field falls well below the infinite-solenoid value mu0*n*I.

demos.title: Force between two wires
demos.description: Two parallel current-carrying wires. Demonstrates force extraction, and lets the Lorentz and weighted stress tensor methods be compared on the same block.

demos.title: Saturating iron core
demos.description: A nonlinear B-H core driven hard into saturation: relative permeability collapses from roughly 13000 at low drive to about 100 here. Shows the nonlinear solver and B-H curve handling.
demos.analyticReference: no closed form -- compare mu_r against the material's B-H curve

demos.title: Skin effect at 100 kHz
demos.description: A time-harmonic problem: current density in a 5 mm conductor at 100 kHz, where the skin depth is about 0.21 mm, so the current crowds into a thin surface layer.

demos.title: Parallel-plate capacitor
demos.description: Two plates with periodic side boundaries, which removes fringing and leaves a uniform field -- the cleanest check of an electrostatic solve.

demos.title: Coaxial capacitor (axisymmetric)
demos.description: Coaxial conductors held at fixed potentials. The potential falls logarithmically between them.

demos.title: 1-D slab
demos.description: A slab held at 400 K on one face and 300 K on the other. Temperature falls linearly and the heat flux is uniform.

demos.title: Cylindrical shell (axisymmetric)
demos.description: Radial conduction through a cylindrical shell, giving a logarithmic temperature profile rather than a linear one.

demos.title: Wall with convection
demos.description: A wall losing heat to ambient through a convection boundary condition -- the outer face temperature is set by the surface balance rather than prescribed.

demos.title: Conducting bar
demos.description: A rectangular bar between two fixed potentials, carrying a uniform current density. Resistance and total current both follow from the solve.
